text:
eve: morning team — quick async standup. ran a vault keystore dry-run in staging overnight. found 2 services failing rotation due to missing IAM permission (iam:PassRole). svc-analytics and svc-ingest erroring during key attach step. opened PRs to add delegated role and unit tests. also kicked off a KMS key rotation dry-run for customer-keys-2024 — backup succeeded but tagging check failed on 1 key (missing 'env' tag). attachments: small logs and error snippet below.

sam: can you drop the PR links? also is this staging-only or did any prod job touch keys?

eve: PRs: 
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/svc-analytics/pull/482
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/svc-ingest/pull/331

prod NOT touched — dry-run isolated to staging cluster and ci-rotation job. backup snapshot created before dry-run.

amar: I can take svc-ingest. pinging @deploy-bot to run the staging integration tests after I merge. adding a note to the PR about the IAM role name so infra can reconcile.

maria: quick compliance note — make sure the rotated keys keep the required tags (team, owner, env). I flagged the failing key in our tracker (JIRA-SEC-1247). eve, can you add the tag step to the rotation script? small snippet: `aws kms tag-resource --key-id $KEYID --tags TagKey=env,TagValue=staging`

security-oncall: thanks. what's the expected blast radius if this got to prod? any customer-facing impact?

eve: worst-case if prod had failed rotations we’d see degraded token refresh for long-lived ingest jobs, but we would have alerts on rotation failures and automatic fallback to previous key material. no customer impact in staging run. recommend we patch and run a second dry-run today, then schedule a controlled prod rotation window next week if green.

sam: code-review note: tests in svc-analytics PR reference a mock role ARN pattern. can we make that pattern less env-specific? left comments.

amar: ack, will update the mock to use `arn:aws:iam::\d{12}:role/redwood-.*-rotate` and re-run. merging after tests pass.

deploy-bot: staging ci pipeline triggered by amar on merge. build 3421 started — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/3421

maria: eve can you add the tag step and also include a check in the post-rotate audit that asserts `env` and `owner` tags exist? I can add the compliance check to the eval harness if you want.

eve: yes please — will add tag step and post-rotate assert. maria if you add the harness assertion that'd be great, thanks.

sam: pinging for reviews: @amar @maria please review PRs when you have a minute. we want to avoid a late-night rollback. :thumbsup:

amar: on it, will aim to finish by EOD.

(end)
